text: For copies of Medicaid-paid claims/payment information, complete the agency request form and include the recipient’s authorization releasing the information. Send it to BenefitRecovery@Medicaid.Alabama.Gov or Alabama Medicaid Agency, Attention: Benefit Recovery Section, PO Box 5624, Montgomery, AL 36103-5624. text: An attorney can expressly request copies of Medicaid-paid claims using the agency form and recipient authorization, sent to the Benefit Recovery Section. title: Reporting the injury
text: No portal. Report by mail or fax to the Arkansas Medicaid TPL Unit. Plan-paid claims: Send subrogation and WC inquiries to Rawlings at CareSourceManualReferrals@rawlingscompany.com or call 855-967-6617. CareSource explicitly excludes only Ohio Medicaid from this published instruction. Contact Rawlings at 888-285-1276 for Arkansas Total Care subrogation involving motor vehicle accidents, casualty/tortfeasor liability, restitution or workers’ compensation. The 2026 plan manual expressly delegates this work. General plan inquiry routes: General Member Services inquiry: call 866-261-1286 and request the person handling a bespoke injury/subrogation matter. Provider Services 855-429-1028 is an alternate general contact. User approves this general route;  a dedicated subrogation unit is not claimed. Known general plan contact: email ARProviderQuestions@Summitcommunitycare.com or call 844-462-0022. Request the plan-designated casualty/subrogation recipient. General member contact 844-405-4295 is also published by Arkansas DHS. The 2019 provider TPL update is claims/COB guidance, not casualty intake. General inquiry contact is known and usable. text: For settlements subject to §9-5-11, send settlement notice including the amount allocated to Medicaid-paid past medical expenses and retain the asserted lien in escrow. The statute provides a consent/rejection process; where the total settlement is below the lien, consent is required before finalization. Section (d)(4) exempts a fully resolving settlement collectively no greater than $20,000 from this section. The source does not prescribe the office’s complete fee/cost, release or distribution attachment checklist.
